outputs.hash_reporting: Final serialized bytes hashed in memory during authoring and reported through tool output; receipt self-hash omitted to avoid circular content.

operations: 1: One exec_command Python process explicitly read all six frozen input files in listed order, SHA256 hashed and printed their complete content; manual review of output. One UTC clock tool call.
2: One exec_command Python process created only the assigned output directory and wrote manifest.ts (initial 3738-byte, 97-line source). No explicit file reads.
3: One exec_command Python process read only own manifest.ts once, hashed, counted lines and printed full source for manual review. One UTC clock tool call.
4: One exec_command Python process read only own manifest.ts once, hashed and counted lines, then revised that same file to await both members of every failed I/O pair.
5: One exec_command Python process read only own final manifest.ts once, hashed, counted lines and printed full source for manual review. One UTC clock tool call.

6: This exec_command Python process authors author-record.json entirely from known in-memory data, reads the UTC clock, serializes and hashes receipt bytes in memory, writes that receipt, and chmods exactly manifest.ts and author-record.json to 0444. No explicit filesystem content reads.

Tool orchestration used functions.exec and exec_command only for the listed authoring, explicit reads, hashing, line counting and chmod; clock tool used for time. No extra scratch/accounting files, subagents or installs.
manual_review: Public exports and signatures match public-api.d.ts; import module, name and type-only sets match imports.json.
Directory recursion fully awaits each listed directory before siblings; candidate symlinks alone receive traversal-time stat; errors on those stats are ignored; traversal failure yields [].

All path discovery precedes per-file I/O. Per-path stat and 30-line read start together in traversal order. Both promises settle before an entry is accepted or omitted; outer allSettled preserves order.
Stable descending mtime sort and 200-entry slice follow all per-file I/O; missing mtime uses zero. Supplied path spelling and native-relative separator normalization are preserved.
Single BOM removal, CRLF normalization, exact opening and first closing marker, YAML parse handling, description truthiness and metadata type fallback follow contract.
Result own-field order is optional description, filePath, filename, mtimeMs, optional type; no unknown frontmatter, body or own undefined optionals escape.
Formatter preserves supplied order and exact bracket/date/description templates, propagates date errors and never uses full filePath.
retained_data_and_idioms: Required original public names, import bindings and type shapes; MEMORY_RECALL_TYPES remains opaque at its original dependency owner and is used for the required four-type membership check.
Required MEMORY.md exclusion, lowercase .md suffix, exact --- markers, metadata/type/description keys, offsetLine 0, limitLines 30, and post-I/O cap 200.
Exact required /^\uFEFF/u and /\r\n/gu regular expressions, slash normalization and output templates including bracket prefix, ISO date parentheses, colon-space description and newline joining.
Ordinary async recursion, paired Promise.allSettled, ordered collection, nullish coalescing, object spread, stable Array.sort and slice; these are not asserted novel.
